description: This file implements a watch mode loop for the Playwright testing framework, managing test execution, file change detection, user input handling, and browser reuse via a server. It includes classes for transport communication, functions for running tests, and UI prompts for user interaction.

classes.name: InMemoryTransport
classes.description: A transport class implementing TestServerTransport for in-memory message passing, extending EventEmitter.

methods.name: runWatchModeLoop
methods.description: Main async function managing the watch mode loop, handling test execution, file change detection, user commands, and browser server toggling.

methods.name: readKeyPress
methods.description: Utility function to read keypresses from stdin, handling user input asynchronously.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Function to initiate test runs with specified options, handling user interruption.

methods.name: readCommand
methods.description: Function to read user commands via keypresses, mapping keys to command strings.

methods.name: printConfiguration
methods.description: Outputs the current test run configuration and command options.

methods.name: printBufferPrompt
methods.description: Displays prompt when in buffer mode, indicating changed files.

methods.name: printPrompt
methods.description: Displays waiting prompt for file changes.

methods.name: toggleShowBrowser
methods.description: Toggles the in-memory browser server for reusing a browser instance.
